raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted ADH physiology by treating “excrete ADH” as lowering effective ADH, leading to the conclusion that dehydration causes more urination. In reality, dehydration increases ADH secretion (from the posterior pituitary), which raises water reabsorption via aquaporins and decreases urine volume; thirst also increases. The planner therefore chose A instead of the correct B.
